Pillar 03 · Decentralized Care Delivery

World-class careat the patient'shome country.

Bringing Indian specialist expertise, equipment, and coordinated clinical protocols directly to overseas partner hospitals.

Explore Care Delivery
01

Patient Identification

Pre-screening dossiers, imaging tele-reviews, and surgical candidate triaging conducted in advance with local general physicians.

02

Specialist Deployment

Senior surgical faculty, scrub teams, and specialized anesthetists dispatched to on-ground facility with sterile equipment.

03

Surgical Camp Execution

Concentrated surgical operating blocks performing joint replacements, neuro-procedures, and pediatric corrections under WHO safety rules.

04

Post-Operative Follow-Up

On-ward management, coordinated handoffs to domestic hospital teams, wound monitoring protocols, and telemedicine reviews.

05

Training & Capacity Building

Structured knowledge transfer to local surgical and nursing teams, ensuring sustainable clinical capability on the ground.

06

Medical Value Travel & Operations

For complex quaternary cases exceeding on-ground capabilities, fast-track direct transfer to top Indian JCI hospitals with pre-cleared visas.

Client Leadership

Clinical leadership

Dr. Kunal Goyal

Executive Director — BMT & Oncology · Clinical Lead, FMC Sulaymaniyah Programme

A pioneer in cellular therapy and one of India's leading haemato-oncologists, Dr. Goyal shapes clinical protocol design and tumour boards across IHM's international programmes.

350+Bone Marrow Transplants Performed
1,000+Patients Treated
10+Years of Clinical Experience

  • Pioneer in Cellular Therapy

    Performed the first-ever CAR-T cell therapy in a private healthcare setup in Navi Mumbai.

  • Principal Investigator, CAR-T Research

    Leads ongoing clinical research programmes in advanced cellular therapies.

  • International Professional Bodies

    Member — American Society of Hematology (ASH), ASCO, ISHBT & ISBMT.

  • Clinical Focus

    High-risk leukaemias, lymphomas, myeloma, thalassaemia, sickle cell anaemia & CAR-T therapy.

His Role for the FMC Programme

Leads clinical protocol design and tumour boards in Phase 1, personally reviews every BMT referral in Phase 2, and serves as founding Clinical Director shaping FMC's own BMT unit in Phase 3.

Explore Clinical Leadership

Dr. Dharma Rakshak Ayapati

Chief Cardio-Thoracic Surgeon · 38 Years of Overall Experience

One of India's most experienced cardio-thoracic surgeons, with international training and research spanning cardiac transplantation, minimally invasive surgery, and complex valve procedures.

38+Years of Experience
M.Ch.Cardio-Thoracic Surgery
2Major International Trials

  • Former Director-Vice Chancellor, NIMS Hyderabad

    Former Director-Vice Chancellor of Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Hyderabad.

  • Advanced International Surgical Training

    Training in cardiac transplantation, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, beating-heart bypass surgery and complex valve surgery.

  • International Cardiac Research

    Contributed to major international cardiac research trials including STICH and CORONARY.

  • Cardiac Surgery Milestones

    Pioneered off-pump coronary bypass surgery at NIMS and achieved significant cardiac-surgery milestones in Andhra Pradesh.
